notes: al-Faqih's statement of his routes to Ibrahim b. Hashim, with no saying (rule 11). Read as four routes and flagged for a ruling.
«محمد بن الحسن» and «عبد الله بن جعفر الحميري» both write «جميعا عن إبراهيم بن هاشم», so their routes meet at Ibrahim (occurrence 2).
Route 4 ends «عن أبيه إبراهيم بن هاشم»: the father is named by the following name, so the name is the link (rule 7).
